episode_text: RMT Soluciones is a construction engineering firm based in Costa Rica. They specialize in hotel-grade, hospital-grade, and residential construction projects including factories and commercial buildings. Services cover the full project lifecycle: inspection, design, build, and development of electrical systems, fire suppression systems, plumbing and water systems, structural engineering, CCTV surveillance, and datacenters. RMT also sells construction products directly to contractors and end clients.
